shared_elements: figure shown frontally/profile against a plain field
justification: Both surfaces show anthropomorphic figures with an arm raised and something small held in the hand, which is about as generic as figural imagery gets. Everything else differs: A is a single, richly detailed, naturalistically modelled winged bearded figure in profile with elaborate garment, bracelets and a flowering plant, whereas B shows several stick-thin, schematic, near-featureless figures with splayed limbs scattered across a field of loose lines.
